en: A vintage street-view postcard showing a busy square with horse-drawn carriages, people walking, and café tables along both sides of the street. Multi‑storey European-style buildings line the square; a sign on the upper-right building partially reads "GRAND …". The caption at the top says "Souvenir de Salonique" and along the bottom "Place de la Liberté" and "Ed. Librairie Italienne". A watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower part of the image.
